method: original DPE (15-head IsoMax+ prototype ensemble with covariance regularization, equal probability averaging at temperature 1.0)

preprocessing: torchvision.transforms.Resize((256, 256)) -> CenterCrop((224, 224)) -> ToTensor() -> ImageNet Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
Forward through Stage-0 ResNet-50 trunk + Flatten to raw 2048-D embedding x
Per-sample row standardization across the 2048 feature dimensions: x_std = (x - mean(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)) / std(x, axis=1, ddof=0, keepdims=True)
L2 normalization of x_std and each class prototype vector along feature dimension (dim=1) inside IsoMax+ distance calculation

inference.evaluation_mode: torch.inference_mode(), temperature=1.0 (training entropic scale 30 is NOT applied at inference)
inference.probability_conversion: For each head m in 1..15: logits_m = -|distance_scale_m| * ||normalize(x_std) - normalize(prototypes_m)||_2; p_m = softmax(logits_m, dim=1)
inference.aggregation: Equal arithmetic mean of the 15 head probability vectors: p = (1/15) * sum_{m=1}^{15} p_m
inference.decision_rule: argmax over averaged [p(landbird), p(waterbird)]; equal probabilities select index 0 (landbird)

selection.procedure: Per-head validation worst-group accuracy (WGA) selection over 20 training epochs per stage (stages 1..15), using >= tie-breaking (latest epoch achieving the maximum validation WGA is retained, matching notebooks/dpe_waterbirds_end_to_end.ipynb)
selection.selection_data: Full official Waterbirds validation split (1,199 examples) with group annotations

verification.scope: Verified numerical equivalence between native utils.isomaxplus.IsoMaxPlusLossFirstPart head ensemble inference and src.evaluation.dpe_export.predict_heads across all 1,199 validation examples (label_agreement: 1.0, max_abs_prob_diff: 5.960464477539063e-08 vs predeclared float32 tolerance 1e-5).

limitations: The historical Kaggle notebook sessions (exp-dpe-waterbirds-ermstar-001 and exp-dpe-waterbirds-standard-002) discarded their in-memory Stage 1+ prototype lists after printing aggregate metrics. This ensemble was newly trained on local CPU (seed=0) using the exact notebook Stage 1+ recipe on the saved Stage-0 backbone checkpoint checkpoints/dpe_ckpt_last.zip.

As documented in erm_stage0_seed0, the Stage-0 backbone checkpoint checkpoints/dpe_ckpt_last.zip achieves 76.64% ERM test WGA and 93.93% DPE test WGA, matching the 100-epoch augmented ERM* track rather than the unaugmented --no_augmentation track.
